data_source: Repository exercise data carried forward unchanged from round 01
description: Three illustrative algorithm trajectories over ten iterations; this is a practice dataset, not an experimental result.

fields.algorithm: Algorithm label: Proposed, Adaptive, or Baseline
fields.objective: Objective value to minimize; no physical unit is supplied

derived_quantities.historical_best: Cumulative minimum of objective within each algorithm trajectory.
derived_quantities.delta_objective: objective[t] - objective[t-1] for consecutive iterations; negative means a decrease under minimization, positive means a temporary increase.
derived_quantities.net_change: objective[last] - objective[first]; negative means the displayed trajectory ends below its starting value.

transformations: Rows are sorted by algorithm and iteration for deterministic rendering only.
No observations are removed, smoothed, interpolated, normalized, aggregated, or winsorized.
Historical best is computed as the direction-aware cumulative minimum for annotation only.
Stepwise change is computed from adjacent raw objective values and is shown with its signed value.

supported: Within the displayed illustrative trajectories, all three algorithms end below their displayed starting values.
The Proposed trajectory has one positive step at iteration 6 and ends at the lowest displayed terminal objective.
The signed update plot separates overall change from the local non-monotone step.
not_supported: Statistical significance, confidence intervals, error bars, or uncertainty bands
Claims about real experiments or competition results
